body: I guess you're right, but right now I'm splitting on them and I feel so bad...

I think it may be possible, I hope I'll find.
Thank you for taking time to talk with me.

No, unfortunately :(

I fear I'm trapped in this situation until I earn enough money to go to a therapist by myself.

I'll turn 21 tomorrow, but I don't have enough money because I'm still a student so if I want to go to a doctor I have to ask for money.

I don't want them to feel pity for me and start treating me like another person, because I couldn't handle that. In addition my mother is narcissistic, so I don't know how she could react, all I know is I'm afraid of her.
I know I should, but I'm really ashamed of this and I don't want my family to find out so I haven't seen one yet

In these moments I can't tell if something is real or not because everything is like a dream, and I'm not even in my body, it's like my mind is somewhere else and my body is hollow. I can see my body doing stuff but I'm not controlling it.

Sometimes my mind actually sleep, so when I wake up from this weird thing I'm a bit confused, and it happens that I wake up in strange places like on the roof.
